The relief is a smooth lens: the vertex thickness proxy (2 x max |z| per 0.02 m radius bin) reads 0.0326, 0.0324, 0.0318, 0.0307, 0.0291, 0.0280, and 0.0259 m from r 0 to 0.16 m, stats.json gives 0.29 x 0.251 x 0.033 m and 2292 triangles, and the normal map atlas shows no ring. The paint still draws one. In the front cutouts the radial mean luma has a thin ring at r 0.103 to 0.110 m, with a peak to trough swing of 6.6 levels for red (5 percent), 10.8 for blue (8 percent), and 3.5 for yellow (2 percent). The median kink over the face is 0.07 to 0.29. The ring also crosses the lobes: in the red cutout at theta 15, 30, 165, 180, 195, and 210 degrees, where a lobe covers the disc edge, the luma at r 110 px is 5.6 to 12.6 levels below the mean of r 104 and 118 px. out/paint-splash/textures/baseColor.png shows the cause: the dark band (assets/paint-splash.ts:119-129) follows the rim of the central disc (r 0.105 to 0.12 m) through the lobes, with lighter lobe ovals inside, and not only the silhouette (briefs/paint-splash.md r2 item 4 says the silhouette). The ring is clearest on blue and faint on yellow. In the three-quarter cutouts the ring makes the face read as a plate inside a rim (a button or a seal), and at the 128 px scale it shows as a faint circle with lobe outlines. The earlier N1 was partly this paint ring. The text 'no ring shows' (assets/paint-splash.ts:108-109) and 'with no ring' (maker-p5-splash-r3.log, final look) hold for the relief only. Suggested change (optional r4, owner decision): paint the band from the outer silhouette only, so it does not cross the lobes, then re-cut and re-check. | owner: maker (measure-jr-green); the PM decides

Item 1, seam cause and fix: src/render/cutout.ts adds readStrips (rows are read in strips of at most 64 and joined; the strip at row y lands at offset y x width x 4, the layout of one whole read), and src/render/page.ts replaces the one gl.readPixels call with it. resolveStraight is unchanged. The maker probe (maker-p5-fix-cutout.log lines 20-33) shows raw row 1364 empty in one 3072 x 3072 read and full in a strip read, and SwiftShader shows no empty row. I did not re-run the probe. Facts that agree: the RED output names row 569 in 4 assets with 596, 58, 440, and 30 solid columns, and my read of the delivered files shows the same column counts at row 569 with alpha 255.0 now. The loss is size specific: my detector finds 0 seam rows in 52 older PNGs cut at 1024 x 1200 (week1/cast 17, week1/gestures 10, week2-7/gestures 25). A fault in the row arithmetic would hit every size, so a read fault in the GPU path fits. The change touches one call site and one new pure function, so it is local.

Item 1, proof: my own detector (all rows, rule: at least 8 columns whose neighbours above and below are alpha 255, and a mean alpha below 229.5) finds 0 seam rows in all 29 PNGs of out/chibi-sprouts/r1/props (24 top level, 4 in presets, 1 in high). It is not vacuous: with row 569 set to alpha 170 on the real sun, flower, easel, and kite alpha, it flags row 569 each time. Pixels at rows 566 to 572 of the sun and flower run smooth in colour with alpha 255.0 (picture at 8x on magenta: no line). Re-cuts at HEAD into /tmp: sun front, sun three-quarter, splash front, splash three-quarter, and lily pad high are md5-equal to the delivered files (5 of 5).

Item 1, test meaning: vitest run tests/cutout.test.ts gave 1 file passed and 6 tests passed. The Red of the maker is 'readStrips is not a function', a missing export, and not a failed assertion. The second new test models the fault (a whole-buffer read loses row 3) and asserts the fault in its own control line, so it fails if the function reads the buffer whole. The first test pins the strip order [0,4], [4,4], [8,2]. Neither test sees the wiring in page.ts (N2). The seam rule gave RED then GREEN on the delivered folders (the maker log: 4 FAIL lines, then result ok), and the real script flags my injected seam with the same words (N2).

Item 2, elevation field (b3460c68): src/cli/forge.ts computes the elevation once, writes it to the manifest, and throws when a folder already has another elevation ('one folder keeps one elevation'). The key is additive. The new props, presets/blue, and presets/yellow manifests now hold elevation 0, and props/high holds 35 with foot point (512, 874). scripts/cutout-check.mjs reads it (a missing key is 0). The level rule is the same expression as before (|lowest row - foot row| of at most 4). The look-down rule asks that the model reaches the foot row (within 4 px) and does not touch the bottom edge. The old rule fails every valid look-down cutout by geometry (the near rim falls 116 px below the foot row), so the maker needed a new rule. Synthetic folder tests on the real script: see N3. Verdict: sound, and no check of a level folder is weakened. Gaps are in N3, N4, N5, and N9.
